import json,os

for c in d['cases']:
    f=c.get('fixture')
    if not f: continue
    p=os.path.join('tests/sdk-conformance/fixtures',f)
    if not os.path.exists(p): missing.append((c['id'],f))
print('cases:',len(d['cases']))
print('missing:',missing)
"
